difficulty_reason: For a ring A and a map phi : F -> M-underlined of module-valued functors with F adequate, the lemma asserts that the cokernel of phi is adequate (statement lines 646-652). The proof reduces first to F being a direct sum of linearly adequate functors by the surjection-from-linear lemma, then chooses the presentations 0 -> L_i -> A^{n_i} -> A^{m_i} of the summands and uses the lifting lemma to choose maps A^{n_i} -> M for each i, assembles the commutative diagram of direct sums, forms the two A-modules Q and P as the indicated cokernels, and concludes by identifying Coker(phi) with the kernel of Q-underlined -> P-underlined, which is adequate (proof lines 654-680). The level is H3: the reduction, the choices, the diagram and the final identification are all displayed.
